data.name: Help
data.value: 5250net, an IBM i console terminal. Usage: 5250net HOST [options] --port NUMBER Default 23, or 992 with TLS. --tls Use direct TLS with certificate validation. --device NAME Request an IBM i display device (up to 10 characters). --code-page NUMBER EBCDIC code page, default 37. --keyboard TYPE IBM keyboard type, default USB. --wide Advertise a 27 by 132 color display. --help Show this help. --version Show the version. Keys: Enter, F1 through F12, Shift+F1 through Shift+F12 for F13 through F24. Tab and Shift+Tab select fields. Home selects the start of the field. Ctrl+Enter sends Field Exit. Keypad plus and minus send Field+ and Field-. End selects the end of its content. Insert toggles insert mode. Delete and Backspace edit. Ctrl+End erases to the end of the field. PageUp and PageDown send Roll keys. Alt+H sends Help. Ctrl+A sends Attention. Ctrl+S sends System Request. Escape resets an input error. Ctrl+Q disconnects.
